name: Keszü (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Keszü (a shield of blue and red with yellow ears of grain and a white horse) above a yellow scroll inscribed KESZÜ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
